functions.name: napi_module_register
functions.signature: void NAPI_CDECL napi_module_register(napi_module* mod);
functions.description: Registers a Node-API (N-API) module using the deprecated structure-based registration (superseded by NAPI_MODULE/NAPI_MODULE_INIT). Intended to be called by the runtime during addon load, not typically by user code.
requirements: This API is deprecated; prefer symbol-based registration via NAPI_MODULE/NAPI_MODULE_INIT.
mod must point to a valid, initialized napi_module structure for the current Node-API version.
Caller must ensure the lifetime of strings and function pointers inside napi_module remains valid during registration.
Not intended to be called multiple times for the same module instance.

functions.name: napi_fatal_error
functions.signature: NAPI_NO_RETURN void NAPI_CDECL napi_fatal_error(const char* location, size_t location_len, const char* message, size_t message_len);
functions.description: Unconditionally terminates the process after reporting a fatal error with an optional source location and message. Use only for unrecoverable conditions.
requirements: Function never returns (noreturn). Caller must not expect control flow to continue.
location may be NULL if no location string is provided; otherwise it must point to a buffer of at least location_len bytes.
message may be NULL if no message is provided; otherwise it must point to a buffer of at least message_len bytes.
location_len and message_len must correctly represent the provided buffers (not rely on NUL-termination).
Should only be used for fatal, unrecoverable errors.

functions.name: napi_async_init
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_async_init(napi_env env, napi_value async_resource, napi_value async_resource_name, napi_async_context* result);
functions.description: Initializes an async context used to associate subsequent async work/callbacks with a given JS async resource and name for async hooks/instrumentation.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
async_resource should be a valid JavaScript object representing the async resource (inferred).
async_resource_name should be a valid JavaScript value (typically a string) naming the resource (inferred).
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created napi_async_context.
Caller must check the returned napi_status and only use the context on success.
The resulting async context must later be destroyed with napi_async_destroy.

functions.name: napi_async_destroy
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_async_destroy(napi_env env, napi_async_context async_context);
functions.description: Cleans up a previously initialized async context created with napi_async_init.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
async_context must be a context previously returned by napi_async_init and not yet destroyed.
Must be called exactly once per successfully created async context (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_make_callback
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_make_callback(napi_env env, napi_async_context async_context, napi_value recv, napi_value func, size_t argc, const napi_value* argv, napi_value* result);
functions.description: Invokes a JavaScript function (func) with a given receiver (recv) and arguments, optionally associated with an async context for proper async hooks behavior. Returns the call result via result.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
func must be a JavaScript function value (inferred).
recv must be a valid JavaScript value used as the this receiver (inferred).
If argc > 0, argv must point to an array of at least argc napi_value items; argv may be NULL only when argc == 0.
result may be NULL if the caller does not need the return value; otherwise must be non-NULL to receive it (inferred).
async_context should be a valid context from napi_async_init or NULL if not applicable (inferred).
Must be called from a thread and state where calling into JS is permitted for the given env (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success or pending exception.

functions.name: napi_create_buffer
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_create_buffer(napi_env env, size_t length, void** data, napi_value* result);
functions.description: Creates a new Node.js Buffer object of the given length. Returns the Buffer as a napi_value and a pointer to its underlying data storage.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
length specifies the number of bytes to allocate; may be zero (inferred).
data may be NULL if the caller does not need direct access; otherwise must be non-NULL to receive the data pointer.
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created Buffer value.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.
The returned data pointer is owned by the Buffer; do not free it manually (inferred).

functions.name: napi_create_external_buffer
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_create_external_buffer(napi_env env, size_t length, void* data, node_api_basic_finalize finalize_cb, void* finalize_hint, napi_value* result);
functions.description: Wraps caller-provided memory (data, length) into a Node.js Buffer without copying. An optional finalize callback is invoked when the Buffer is garbage-collected to clean up the external memory.
requirements: This function is unavailable if NODE_API_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS_ALLOWED is defined at compile time.
env must be a valid N-API environment.
data must point to at least length bytes of memory valid for the Buffer’s lifetime.
finalize_cb may be NULL if no finalizer is needed; if provided, it will be called with finalize_hint when the Buffer is collected (inferred).
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created Buffer value.
Caller is responsible for ensuring the external memory remains valid until the Buffer is finalized (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: node_api_create_buffer_from_arraybuffer
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL node_api_create_buffer_from_arraybuffer(napi_env env, napi_value arraybuffer, size_t byte_offset, size_t byte_length, napi_value* result);
functions.description: Creates a Node.js Buffer that views a region of an existing JavaScript ArrayBuffer without copying, starting at byte_offset for byte_length bytes.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 10.
env must be a valid N-API environment.
arraybuffer must be a JavaScript ArrayBuffer object (inferred).
byte_offset and byte_length must specify a range within the underlying ArrayBuffer; the sum must not exceed the ArrayBuffer’s byte length (inferred).
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created Buffer value.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_create_buffer_copy
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_create_buffer_copy(napi_env env, size_t length, const void* data, void** result_data, napi_value* result);
functions.description: Creates a new Buffer of size length and copies length bytes from data into it. Returns both the Buffer value and a pointer to the newly allocated Buffer storage.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
If length > 0, data must point to at least length readable bytes; data may be NULL only if length == 0 (inferred).
result_data may be NULL if the caller does not need the storage pointer; otherwise must be non-NULL to receive it.
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created Buffer value.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.
The returned result_data is owned by the Buffer; do not free it manually (inferred).

functions.name: napi_is_buffer
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_is_buffer(napi_env env, napi_value value, bool* result);
functions.description: Determines whether the given JavaScript value is a Node.js Buffer. Writes true/false to result.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the boolean outcome.
value may be any JavaScript value.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_get_buffer_info
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_get_buffer_info(napi_env env, napi_value value, void** data, size_t* length);
functions.description: Retrieves the underlying data pointer and length of a Node.js Buffer.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
value must be a Buffer object; otherwise the call will fail (inferred).
data may be NULL if the caller only needs length; otherwise must be non-NULL to receive the data pointer.
length may be NULL if the caller only needs data; otherwise must be non-NULL to receive the length.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.
The returned data pointer is owned by the Buffer and must not be freed (inferred).

functions.name: napi_create_async_work
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_create_async_work(napi_env env, napi_value async_resource, napi_value async_resource_name, napi_async_execute_callback execute, napi_async_complete_callback complete, void* data, napi_async_work* result);
functions.description: Creates an async work item with user-provided execute and complete callbacks, optionally associated with an async resource and name for async hooks. The work can later be queued and executed.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
async_resource should be a valid JS object identifying the resource (inferred).
async_resource_name should be a valid JS value (typically a string) naming the resource (inferred).
execute must be a valid function pointer; it will run on a worker thread (inferred).
complete must be a valid function pointer; it will run on the main thread after execute finishes (inferred).
data is an opaque pointer passed to the callbacks; may be NULL.
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created napi_async_work handle.
Created work must be deleted with napi_delete_async_work when no longer needed (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success before using the work handle.

functions.name: napi_delete_async_work
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_delete_async_work(napi_env env, napi_async_work work);
functions.description: Deletes a previously created async work item and releases its resources. Should be called after work has completed or has been canceled.
requirements: env must be a valid N-API environment.
work must be a valid handle previously returned by napi_create_async_work.
Must be called exactly once per created work handle (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_queue_async_work
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_queue_async_work(node_api_basic_env env, napi_async_work work);
functions.description: Queues a created async work item for execution on the libuv thread pool.
requirements: env must be a valid basic N-API environment (node_api_basic_env).
work must be a valid handle returned by napi_create_async_work and not yet queued or completed (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_cancel_async_work
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_cancel_async_work(node_api_basic_env env, napi_async_work work);
functions.description: Attempts to cancel a previously queued async work item.
requirements: env must be a valid basic N-API environment (node_api_basic_env).
work must be a valid handle previously returned by napi_create_async_work.
Cancellation may fail if the work has already started executing (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for the outcome.

functions.name: napi_get_node_version
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_get_node_version(node_api_basic_env env, const napi_node_version** version);
functions.description: Retrieves a pointer to the current Node.js version information structure for the given environment.
requirements: env must be a valid basic N-API environment (node_api_basic_env).
version must be a non-NULL pointer to receive a pointer to a const napi_node_version structure.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.
The returned napi_node_version pointer is owned by the runtime; do not modify or free it (inferred).

functions.name: napi_get_uv_event_loop
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_get_uv_event_loop(node_api_basic_env env, struct uv_loop_s** loop);
functions.description: Returns the current libuv event loop associated with the provided environment.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 2.
env must be a valid basic N-API environment (node_api_basic_env).
loop must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the uv_loop_s pointer.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.
The returned loop pointer is owned by the runtime; do not free it (inferred).

functions.name: napi_fatal_exception
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_fatal_exception(napi_env env, napi_value err);
functions.description: Reports a JavaScript exception as a fatal exception to the runtime’s uncaught exception handling, typically terminating the process or invoking the fatal exception workflow.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 3.
env must be a valid N-API environment.
err must be a JavaScript Error object (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success or error.

functions.name: napi_add_env_cleanup_hook
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_add_env_cleanup_hook(node_api_basic_env env, napi_cleanup_hook fun, void* arg);
functions.description: Registers a cleanup hook to be called when the N-API environment is being cleaned up or destroyed. The hook is invoked with the provided arg.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 3.
env must be a valid basic N-API environment (node_api_basic_env).
fun must be a valid function pointer to a cleanup hook.
arg is an opaque pointer passed to the hook; may be NULL.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_remove_env_cleanup_hook
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_remove_env_cleanup_hook(node_api_basic_env env, napi_cleanup_hook fun, void* arg);
functions.description: Unregisters a previously added environment cleanup hook matching the function pointer and arg.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 3.
env must be a valid basic N-API environment (node_api_basic_env).
fun and arg must match a previously registered cleanup hook.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_open_callback_scope
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_open_callback_scope(napi_env env, napi_value resource_object, napi_async_context context, napi_callback_scope* result);
functions.description: Opens a callback scope for invoking JavaScript callbacks, associating the call with a resource object and async context for proper async hooks behavior. Returns a scope handle that must later be closed.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 3.
env must be a valid N-API environment.
resource_object should be a valid JavaScript object representing the resource (inferred).
context should be a valid async context or NULL if not applicable (inferred).
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the opened scope handle.
Each opened scope must be closed with napi_close_callback_scope.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_close_callback_scope
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_close_callback_scope(napi_env env, napi_callback_scope scope);
functions.description: Closes a previously opened callback scope created with napi_open_callback_scope.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 3.
env must be a valid N-API environment.
scope must be a valid scope previously returned by napi_open_callback_scope and not already closed.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_create_threadsafe_function
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_create_threadsafe_function(napi_env env, napi_value func, napi_value async_resource, napi_value async_resource_name, size_t max_queue_size, size_t initial_thread_count, void* thread_finalize_data, napi_finalize thread_finalize_cb, void* context, napi_threadsafe_function_call_js call_js_cb, napi_threadsafe_function* result);
functions.description: Creates a thread-safe function that allows native threads to call into JavaScript by queueing data and invoking a JS callback on the main thread. Supports queue size limits, reference counting, and a finalizer for thread-specific data.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 4.
env must be a valid N-API environment.
func must be a JavaScript function to be called on the main thread (inferred).
async_resource should be a valid JS object identifying the async resource (inferred).
async_resource_name should be a valid JS value (typically a string) naming the resource (inferred).
max_queue_size sets the maximum queued items; 0 may indicate an unlimited queue depending on implementation (inferred).
initial_thread_count specifies how many threads will hold references to the TSFN initially (inferred).
thread_finalize_cb may be NULL; if provided, it will be called with thread_finalize_data when the TSFN is being destroyed (inferred).
context is an opaque pointer passed to call_js_cb; may be NULL (inferred).
call_js_cb must be a valid function to convert native data to JS and call func on the main thread (inferred).
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the created napi_threadsafe_function handle.
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_get_threadsafe_function_context
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_get_threadsafe_function_context(napi_threadsafe_function func, void** result);
functions.description: Retrieves the user-provided context pointer associated with a thread-safe function created via napi_create_threadsafe_function.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 4.
func must be a valid napi_threadsafe_function handle.
result must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the context pointer (which may be NULL).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_call_threadsafe_function
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_call_threadsafe_function(napi_threadsafe_function func, void* data, napi_threadsafe_function_call_mode is_blocking);
functions.description: Queues data to be delivered to the JavaScript callback associated with a thread-safe function, optionally blocking if the queue is full depending on is_blocking.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 4.
func must be a valid napi_threadsafe_function handle.
data is an opaque pointer passed to the call_js_cb; may be NULL depending on the callback’s expectations (inferred).
is_blocking must be a valid napi_threadsafe_function_call_mode value (blocking or non-blocking).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success; non-blocking calls may return a queue-full status (inferred).

functions.name: napi_acquire_threadsafe_function
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_acquire_threadsafe_function(napi_threadsafe_function func);
functions.description: Increments the internal thread count/reference for a thread-safe function to indicate another thread intends to use it.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 4.
func must be a valid napi_threadsafe_function handle.
Each acquire must eventually be balanced by a release via napi_release_threadsafe_function (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_release_threadsafe_function
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_release_threadsafe_function(napi_threadsafe_function func, napi_threadsafe_function_release_mode mode);
functions.description: Decrements the thread count/reference for a thread-safe function and, depending on mode, may stop further calls and schedule finalization when the count reaches zero.
requirements: Available only when compiled with NAPI_VERSION >= 4.
func must be a valid napi_threadsafe_function handle.
mode must be a valid napi_threadsafe_function_release_mode indicating behavior on release (inferred).
Every prior acquire (including initial_thread_count) must eventually be released (inferred).
Caller must check the returned napi_status for success.

functions.name: napi_unref_threadsafe_function
functions.signature: napi_status NAPI_CDECL napi_unref_threadsafe_function(node_api_basic_env env, napi_threadsafe_function func);

import random
import struct
from typing import List

# Generator for arbitrary binary string payloads suitable for FUZZ_PARAM_STR / FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME.
# Produces valid byte sequences (may include NULs) up to 4096 bytes, seeded randomness.

_MAX_SIZE = 4096


def _rand_ascii(r: random.Random, min_len: int, max_len: int) -> bytes:
    length = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    alphabet = (
        "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
        "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        "0123456789-_:. ,/\\\t\n\r"
    )
    out = bytearray()
    for _ in range(length):
        ch = r.choice(alphabet)
        out.extend(ch.encode("ascii"))
    return bytes(out)


def _safe_code_point(r: random.Random, ranges) -> int:
    # Pick a code point from provided inclusive ranges, skipping surrogate halves.
    while True:
        start, end = r.choice(ranges)
        cp = r.randint(start, end)
        if 0xD800 <= cp <= 0xDFFF:
            continue  # skip surrogates
        return cp


def _rand_utf8(r: random.Random, min_len: int, max_len: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    target = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    while len(out) < target:
        choice = r.random()
        if choice < 0.6:
            out.append(r.randint(0x20, 0x7E))  # printable ASCII
        elif choice < 0.75:
            cp = _safe_code_point(r, [(0x80, 0x7FF)])
            out.extend(chr(cp).encode("utf-8", "strict"))
        elif choice < 0.85:
            cp = _safe_code_point(r, [(0x800, 0xFFFF)])
            out.extend(chr(cp).encode("utf-8", "strict"))
        elif choice < 0.9:
            cp = _safe_code_point(r, [(0x10000, 0x10FFFF)])
            out.extend(chr(cp).encode("utf-8", "strict"))
        else:
            out.append(r.randint(0x80, 0xFF))  # arbitrary high-bit byte
    return bytes(out[:target])


def _edge_cases(r: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    return [
        b"",  # empty
        b"\x00",
        b"\x00\x00\x00",
        b"true",
        b"false",
        b"null",
        b"undefined",
        b"NaN",
        b"Infinity",
        b"-Infinity",
        b"0",
        b"1",
        b"-1",
        b"[]",
        b"{}",
        b"{\"a\":1}",
        b"{\"length\":2147483647}",
        b"function(){return 42}",
        b"class C{}",
        b"Symbol(\"x\")",
        b"/tmp/fake/path.txt",
        b"C:\\temp\\file.bin",
        b"./relative/path",
        b"..\\up\\one",
        b"name_with_unicode_\xE2\x98\x83",  # UTF-8 snowman
        b"A" * 32,
        b"B" * 128,
    ]


def _compose_payload(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    parts: List[bytes] = []

    magic = r.choice([b"TXT\x00", b"BIN\x00", b"JSON\x00", b"DATA\x00"])
    parts.append(magic)

    if r.random() < 0.7:
        key = _rand_ascii(r, 3, 8).replace(b"\n", b"")
        try:
            key = key.decode("ascii", errors="ignore").encode("ascii")
        except Exception:
            key = b"key"
        val = r.randint(-10, 10)
        parts.append(b"{\"" + key + b"\": " + str(val).encode("ascii") + b"}")

    if r.random() < 0.6:
        parts.append(b"\x00\n\x00")

    if r.random() < 0.8:
        base = _rand_ascii(r, 3, 10).replace(b" ", b"_")
        ext = r.choice([b".txt", b".json", b".bin", b".dat", b".js"])
        prefix = r.choice([b"/tmp/", b"/var/tmp/", b"./", b"../", b"C:/temp/", b"C\\\\temp\\\\"]) 
        parts.append(prefix + base + ext)

    parts.append(_rand_utf8(r, 16, 64))

    ec = _edge_cases(r)
    r.shuffle(ec)
    parts.extend(ec[:r.randint(3, 7)])

    body = b"".join(parts)
    parts.append(struct.pack('<I', len(body)))

    payload = b"".join(parts)
    if len(payload) > _MAX_SIZE:
        payload = payload[:_MAX_SIZE]
    return payload


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)

    style = r.randint(0, 3)
    if style == 0:
        payload = _compose_payload(r)
    elif style == 1:
        raw = _rand_ascii(r, 64, 256)
        inserts = [b"\x00", b"{}", b"[]", b"(\n)"]
        for token in inserts:
            if r.random() < 0.5 and len(raw) + len(token) < _MAX_SIZE:
                raw += token
        payload = raw
    elif style == 2:
        bin_part = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(r.randint(32, 128)))
        txt_part = _rand_utf8(r, 32, 128)
        payload = bin_part + b"\n--\n" + txt_part
    else:
        paths = [
            b"/tmp/sample.txt", b"./script.js", b"../data.bin", b"C:/temp/test.json",
            b"/var/tmp/large_file.dat", b"C\\temp\\node_addon.dll",
        ]
        payload = r.choice(paths)
        if r.random() < 0.7:
            q = _rand_ascii(r, 3, 12).replace(b" ", b"+")
            payload = (payload + b"?q=" + q)[:_MAX_SIZE]

    if len(payload) > _MAX_SIZE:
        payload = payload[:_MAX_SIZE]
    return payload
